capabilities.justification: Reads score files from caller-provided paths via parse_score_file and parse_portable_score_file.
Writes WAV audio files to caller-provided paths via render_score_to_wav_file and render_portable_score_to_wav_file.

justification: Provides text score and portable multi-track score parsing, deterministic JSON interchange, additive instrument modeling, percussion kit rendering, PCM synthesis, and WAV file export.
